items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree is preferred.
A minimum of 3 years of golf coaching or playing experience is required. Experience with effective leadership, communication, coaching, and recruiting skills is preferred.
Coordinate and manage the Men’s and Women’s Golf programs through the 2026–27 season, including practices, competition, and oversight of any assistant coaches.
Provide continuity, mentorship, and support for current student-athletes during the coaching transition.
Manage the spring competition schedule, team travel, and related logistics; schedule competitions with other colleges as needed.
Maintain recruiting contacts and support recruitment of qualified student-athletes.
Coordinate the promotion of the Men’s and Women’s Golf programs, including alumni relations.
Perform administrative tasks including budget management.
Appreciation for the role of athletics in small liberal arts colleges with rigorous academic settings.
Ability to teach, mentor, and support student-athletes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.
Represent Pomona-Pitzer and the Men’s and Women’s Golf programs in a professional manner.
Act as a role model in all settings and foster an environment of respect, integrity, and responsibility.
Exemplify a sense of professionalism with student-athletes, opponents, parents, faculty, and staff.
Attend all required athletic department meetings, conference meetings, and events.
Understanding of NCAA Division III philosophy and NCAA and Conference rules compliance.
Perform special projects/tasks/duties and provide assistance as assigned.
